newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 26.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Feb. 26:

WASHINGTON - Giant Food Inc. said that during the five-week strike by Teamster delivery drivers and the two-week period after the dispute, sales dropped $75 million over the same period the previous year.

ANAHEIM, Calif. - Shareholders of the Walt Disney Co. overwhelmingly approved a lucrative bonus package for Chief Executive Michael Eisner, but not before stockholder protests made the company's normally upbeat annual meeting seem like the grumpiest place on earth.
WASHINGTON - As a symbol of success, the cigar is on a roll and, surprised by the demand, manufacturers are finding it impossible to keep up.
WASHINGTON - AT & T is betting on wireless technology as an important way to penetrate the country's $100 billion-a-year local telephone market.
